assumptions: Runic labels are metadata and do not change the Hilbert-space dimension.
A rune becomes computationally meaningful only when mapped to an explicit state, operator or measurement.
mechanism: The runic layer provides symbolic labels for a finite-dimensional Hilbert-space model while preserving the established state, operator and measurement rules.
confusion_guard: This bridge represents a proposed notation layer; it does not establish runes as physical operators or validate cosmological claims.
stop_reason: The complete rune-to-object dictionary and independent physical implementation are still missing.
